title: a fractional argument to an integer-typed variable is refused, not truncated
note: run.py cannot compare two steps' answers, so run_workflow's 'the same message' is asserted by pinning today's message whole in steps 1 and 2. Step 2 sends acknowledged_cost=true as the prose does: if the refusal ever regresses, this step queues a real job.

steps.label: step 2: run_workflow refuses before queueing, same message, no job_id
